title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics.cpp:40–49 perfect-gas conserved-state pressure and :67–73 Euler flux; report.tex:40 describes Newtonian/Fourier viscous terms.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:64–129 reads CGNS coordinates, BCs and element sections, :140–145 builds polygon geometry and rejects degenerate areas.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:696–775 assembles face fluxes, :948–950 globally reduces residual norms; workspace validator passes all cases, without proving accuracy.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.cpp:82–94 implements Rusanov local Lax–Friedrichs, while solver.cpp:768–775 also offers HLLC selection; no entropy-fixed Roe claim.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:303–347 characteristic farfield and :735–775 slip/no-slip impermeable wall paths; :1801–04 outputs boundary no-slip values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:535–553 computes conditioned least-squares gradients; :637–664 applies limiter and pressure-jump fallback. Production controls for earlier cases and executable remain unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:604–626 bounds reconstructed primitive extrema, :646–664 applies pressure-sensor fallback; physics.cpp:40–62 enforces physical state. Historical limiter activations not independently established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:1741–49 projects viscous traction to tangent and :1806–19 calculates wall cf; primitive-gradient shock coupling remains a limitation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:2393–2405 ends steady solve on residual target plus 30-row Cd range; this short Cd-only check can mistake a turning point for sustained convergence, as M200 laminar final200 demonstrates.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:2472–2609 preserves BDF history, measures full transient defect, retries and accepts only target; canonical t=300 force history supports period6.12257 and St0.16333. Historical binary unbound; no rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition.cpp:73–78, neighbour Isend/Irecv :81–89, state/gradient exchange solver.cpp:507,667–668 and global reductions :948–950,1760 are implemented. Reported M015 rank comparison differs 73.81% relatively at near-zero Cd but 0.000892 absolute, with different endpoints and unbound binaries; retain uncertainty without asserting DQ4.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
